name: colombia.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 2 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.
lesson: Validate each JSON-LD block after every release. One stray comma hides all of it.
summary: www.colombia.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Google consent message was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), Microsoft Clarity (2 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies _ga_1LFMK3Q1K1, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 2 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /cine/cartelera/, /futbol/liga-colombiana/nacional-y-sus-posibilidades-de-meterse-en-mundial-de-clubes-608560. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /cambio-moneda/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Select element must have an accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example select[name="p"] and select[name="t"]. Impact: critical.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 98 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 0.4 s
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
